0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Pistons host the Boston Celtics, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Detroit a 50% chance of winning. The Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, and their most recent meeting was a 104-103 win in Detroit on January 19, 2026. Eight Celtics are listed as day-to-day with rest as the reason and are game-time decisions: Derrick White, Jayson Tatum, Mike Conley, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta, Paul George, Payton Pritchard and Sam Hauser.
